2608.04655.title: CSGen: A Multi-Domain Curvilinear Structure Generation Model via Hierarchical Multimodal Diffusion
2608.04655.paper_summary: Curvilinear structure analysis is an important and fundamental task in multimedia. However, the controllable generation of images with precise curvilinear structure objects remains an open challenge. To address this, we propose CSGen, a hierarchical multimodal diffusion model that synthesizes high-fidelity images precisely aligned with multiple control conditions. The CSGen is built upon three key innovations: 1) We construct a multi-domain and multimodal dataset, including over 24K samples from 5 domains and 7 different types of annotations, to train the unified generation model. 2) We propose a novel hierarchical progressive control strategy that decouples topology clues from visual context by a phased signal injection, mitigating semantic drift while ensuring the topological integrity of sparse structures. 3) We design a sparsity-aware loss re-weighting mechanism to address the extreme sparsity of curvilinear structures, significantly enhancing the attention on thin and fragile structures during optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CSGen generates images with superior structure accuracy and visual realism, significantly improving downstream segmentation performance while maintaining robustness across diverse prompts. Our results confirm CSGen as a scalable, data-centric paradigm for the analysis of complex curvilinear structures in diverse multimedia applications. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ShanZard/CSGen.
2608.04655.paper_summary_zh: 曲線結構分析是多媒體中的一項重要且基本的任務。<lb/>然而，精確控制生成具有曲線結構物體的圖像仍然是一個未解決的挑戰。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了CSGen，一種層次化的多模態擴散模型，能夠合成精確對齊多個控制條件的高保真圖像。<lb/>CSGen建立在三項關鍵創新之上：<lb/>1) 我們構建了一個多領域和多模態數據集，包括來自5個領域和7種不同類型註釋的超過24K樣本，以訓練統一生成模型。<lb/>2) 我們提出了一種新穎的層次化漸進控制策略，通過分階信號注入將拓撲線索與視覺上下文解耦，減輕語義漂移的同時確保稀疏結構的拓撲完整性。<lb/>3) 我們設計了一種考慮稀疏性的損失重加權機制，以應對曲線結構的極端稀疏性，顯著增強在優化過程中對細小和脆弱結構的關注。<lb/>大量實驗表明，CSGen生成的圖像在結構準確性和視覺真實性方面優於其他方法，顯著改善下游分割性能，同時在多樣提示中保持穩健性。<lb/>我們的結果確認CSGen是一種可擴展的、以數據為中心的範式，適用於在多樣的多媒體應用中分析複雜的曲線結構。<lb/>代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/ShanZard/CSGen 獲得。
